page_title: FRA 2-1 DEN | France v Denmark 26/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.
90+6' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle. Alexander Bah (Denmark) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+5' Some patient build-up play from France as they look to unlock the defence.
90+2' Didier Deschamps prepares a substitution. Antoine Griezmann is replaced by Youssouf Fofana (France).
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Rasmus Kristensen is given a rest as he is replaced by Alexander Bah (Denmark).

90+1' Kylian Mbappe (France) receives a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and without any hesitation fires the ball goalwards. It fails to worry the goalkeeper as it goes to the middle of the goal.
90+1' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:2.
89' Joachim Andersen (Denmark) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
88' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) sends a cross into the box, but Hugo Lloris comes off his line to gather the ball.
86' 2 - 1 Antoine Griezmann plays a terrific cross over to Kylian Mbappe (France), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Christian Norgaard (Denmark) coming on for Jesper Lindstrom.
84' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

81' Golden chance! Martin Braithwaite (Denmark) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.
80' The cross fools the defence and leaves Adrien Rabiot (France) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just over the bar.
79' Kasper Schmeichel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Antoine Griezmann (France).
79' Jules Kounde (France) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. France win a corner.
79' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (France). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

78' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) leaps like a salmon to produce a header from the resulting corner, but one of the defending players intercepts the ball and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. France will have a chance to score from a corner.
78' Antoine Griezmann (France) steps up to send the ball in.

78' Adrien Rabiot (France) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. France have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Kylian Mbappe (France) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
76' Antoine Griezmann (France) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
76' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (France) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for France.
75' Substitution. Kingsley Coman (France) on for Ousmane Dembele.
75' Didier Deschamps has decided to make a change. Ibrahima Konate (France) replaces Raphael Varane.
73' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mikkel Damsgaard as he is replaced by Kasper Dolberg (Denmark).

73' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Hugo Lloris shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
71' Kylian Mbappe (France) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kasper Schmeichel intercepts the ball.
71' Adrien Rabiot (France) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' 1 - 1 GOAL! The corner comes over and Joachim Andersen wins a simple header before Andreas Christensen (Denmark) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
68' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) will deliver the corner kick.

67' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Denmark will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
63' Substitution. Olivier Giroud is replaced by Marcus Thuram (France).
61' 1 - 0 Goal Kylian Mbappe (France)! Kylian Mbappe (France) was put through by Theo Hernandez and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
61' The total number of attempts is 14:2.
60' Antoine Griezmann (France) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
58' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Szymon Marciniak blows for a foul.
57' Antoine Griezmann (France) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

57' Kasper Schmeichel makes a brilliant save! Kylian Mbappe (France) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes straight under the crossbar but is saved by the keeper!
56' Mikkel Damsgaard (Denmark) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
55' Martin Braithwaite (Denmark) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
55' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

55' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Martin Braithwaite (Denmark), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Denmark.
54' Kasper Schmeichel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kylian Mbappe (France) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
53' Antoine Griezmann (France) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
52' Corner kick. Christian Eriksen (Denmark) is ready to send the ball into the box.

51' Martin Braithwaite (Denmark) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
48' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
48' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Denmark) tries to find Jesper Lindstrom, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
47' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) is penalised for holding. Szymon Marciniak signals a set piece.
46' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' Andreas Cornelius will be replaced by Martin Braithwaite (Denmark).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Kylian Mbappe (France) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (France) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' The ball is played back to Christian Eriksen (Denmark), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
43' The game has begun to heat up. Jules Kounde (France) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
41' Dangerous play by Andreas Cornelius (Denmark). Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle for a foul.

40' Ousmane Dembele sprays a pass out to Kylian Mbappe (France), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Denmark.
39' Olivier Giroud (France) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
38' A pass by Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

37' Olivier Giroud (France) climbs all over the defender near the penalty spot to win the ball from a cross by Kylian Mbappe, but plants his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Denmark will have a goal kick.
36' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
35' The free kick into the penalty area from Antoine Griezmann (France) is cleared.
35' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) was too forceful with his tackle and Szymon Marciniak interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Another situation results in a direct free kick for France.
34' Adrien Rabiot (France) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
34' Jules Kounde (France) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
34' Ousmane Dembele (France) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
33' Antoine Griezmann (France) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Kasper Schmeichel.
33' 5:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.

32' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.
30' Jules Kounde (France) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
30' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
28' A lofted cross from Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The linesman signals a throw-in for Denmark.
25' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
23' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
22' Rough tackle by Adrien Rabiot (France). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

21' Adrien Rabiot (France) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Kasper Schmeichel shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
20' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andreas Christensen (Denmark) was quite harsh and Szymon Marciniak didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' Theo Hernandez (France) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Olivier Giroud.
16' Olivier Giroud (France) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
14' Ousmane Dembele (France) commits a rough foul. Szymon Marciniak stops the game and makes a call.
13' Raphael Varane (France) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
13' Antoine Griezmann (France) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
13' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Antoine Griezmann (France), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and France will have a corner.
12' It looks like Joachim Andersen (Denmark) saw red with that tackle. Szymon Marciniak won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
11' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Hugo Lloris, who smothers the ball.
10' Theo Hernandez (France) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
7' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
6' Ousmane Dembele (France) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
6' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
4' Kylian Mbappe (France) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' A cross from Joakim Maehle (Denmark) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
3' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle for a foul.
2' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Joakim Maehle (Denmark), but the defence gets it clear.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Denmark will have the kick-off.
Szymon Marciniak was nominated as the referee for this game.
